title: Cabling conjecture
statement: Cabling conjecture · 1983. González-Acuña and Short proposed that reducible surgery on a nontrivial knot must be cabling surgery on a cable knot (history).

counterexample.description: Give a noncable knot and slope with reducible filling. Exact triangulations and a normal essential-sphere certificate verify reducibility; JSJ data certify noncabling.
